name: Proton Pass
author: Elliot
description: Search and copy Proton Pass logins from the Omarchy bar, in an Apple Passwords-style popover.

barWidget.description: Search Proton Pass logins and copy passwords from the bar.

schema.label: pass-cli path
schema.description: Command used to talk to Proton Pass. Use a full path if pass-cli is not on PATH.

schema.label: Cache lifetime (minutes)
schema.description: How long login titles stay on disk before a background refresh. Opening the panel always uses the cache; passwords are never stored.
